name: Kent Connelly
occupation: Lincoln County commissioner (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Lincoln County commissioner (listed on the official commissioners page; lost the August 2026 Republican primary)
background: Kent Connelly is a Lincoln County commissioner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. The official commissioners page lists him as a member. SVI-NEWS reported that the incumbent finished fifth in the August 2026 Republican primary with 931 votes. Incoming commissioner Jesica Lozier takes office in January 2027.
